optimizer.gradient_sign_convention: Negative loss gradient (-dE/dx, -dE/dW): kLogregSoftmaxGrad writes coeff * (1_{label==c} - p_c), so Weights::update adds _weightsInc directly to _weights.
optimizer.update_rule: With negative batch-averaged gradient g = -(1/numCases) * sum_n dE_n/dW (when weightUpdateFreq == 1 and superEps <= 0), V <- momW * V + epsW * g - wc * epsW * W, then W <- W + V. Biases use separate epsB and momB with wc = 0 and wball = 0; FCLayer (useGrad=false when unshared) folds momW and epsW/numCases directly into _weightsInc during bpropWeights before Weights::update subtracts wc * epsW * W.
optimizer.post_update_constraints: After updating W and B, WeightLayer::updateWeights calls constrainWeights() for wcNormMin/wcNormMax (conv) and wball (conv/fc), both inactive (0) throughout layer-params-145.cfg.

relu.forward_semantics: Applies elementwise rectified linear activation y = (x < 0.0f ? 0.0f : x) to its single input matrix.
relu.backward_semantics: Multiplies upstream gradient elementwise by the strict positivity indicator of the cached output activation: dx = dy * (y > 0.0f) (accumulating into target when add is true).

data.backward_semantics: Produces no input gradients (isGradProducer() returns false; terminal data source).

conv.inputs_spec: 1 or more square multi-channel image inputs in comma-delimited order; each input i has its own weight matrix W[i] of C-order shape (filterChannels[i]*filterSize[i]^2, filters) summed into a common (filters * modulesX^2, numCases) output.
conv.forward_semantics: Accumulates 2D cross-correlation convFilterActs over all inputs i onto a modulesX x modulesX grid (with modulesX = 1 + ceil((2*padding + imgSize - filterSize)/stride) and out-of-bounds pixels zero-padded from paddingStart = -padding), then adds per-filter sharedBiases (or unshared per-module biases) once.
conv.backward_semantics: Computes bias gradient summed over spatial modules and batch/numCases (when epsB > 0), per-input weight gradient via convWeightActs reduced across modules/partialSum and scaled by 1/numCases (when epsW[i] > 0), and input gradient via convImgActs toward upstream gradConsumers.

cmrnorm.inputs_spec: Single square multi-channel image input (num_inputs = 1); channels must be divisible by 16 and 2 <= size <= channels.
cmrnorm.forward_semantics: Normalizes each pixel across adjacent feature maps (sliding window [max(0, c - size/2), min(C, c - size/2 + size)) when blocked=false, or contiguous size-blocks when blocked=true) using addScale = scale / size: denom = minDiv + addScale * sum_f x_f^2 and y_c = x_c * denom^(-pow).
cmrnorm.backward_semantics: Propagates gradients across the channel window via convResponseNormCrossMapUndo using cached _denoms: dx_c = dy_c * denom_c^(-pow) + x_c * sum_{f : c in W(f)} (-2 * addScale * pow * y_f * dy_f / denom_f).

rnorm.inputs_spec: Single square multi-channel image input (num_inputs = 1); 1 <= size <= imgSize.
rnorm.forward_semantics: Normalizes each channel independently over a clamped spatial size x size window around (y, x) using addScale = scale / (size^2) and fixed additive constant 1.0f (minDiv is not used): denom = 1.0f + addScale * sum_{(y',x') in W(y,x)} x^2 and y = x * denom^(-pow).
rnorm.backward_semantics: Propagates gradients within each channel's spatial neighborhood via convResponseNormUndo using cached _denoms: dx = dy * denom^(-pow) + x * sum_{(y',x') : (y,x) in W(y',x')} (-2 * addScale * pow * y' * dy' / denom').

pool.inputs_spec: Single square multi-channel image input (num_inputs = 1); channels divisible by 16 if any gradConsumer lies below.

outputsX.default: 0 (computed as ceil((imgSize - start - sizeX) / float(stride)) + 1 when <= 0)

pool.forward_semantics: For pool=max, computes per-channel spatial maximum over each clamped window [max(0, start + o*stride), min(imgSize, start + o*stride + sizeX)) on an outputsX x outputsX grid (outputsX = ceil((imgSize - start - sizeX)/stride) + 1).
pool.backward_semantics: For pool=max, convLocalMaxUndo routes each pooled output gradient mg to every input pixel in its window whose value equals the pooled maximum (img == ma), summing across overlapping windows and giving all tied maxima the full upstream gradient.

fc.inputs_spec: 1 or more flattened vector inputs in comma-delimited order; each input i owns a separate F-order weight matrix W[i] of shape (numInputs[i], outputs), transposed activations (numCases, outputs) in Layer(..., trans=true).

initW.default: 0.01 nominal in WeightLayerParser, but safe_get_list calls float.split(',') and raises LayerParsingError if omitted

fc.forward_semantics: Accumulates matrix products X[i] * W[i] across all inputs i in declared order (with X[i] transposed to (numCases, numInputs[i]) and W[i] of shape (numInputs[i], outputs)), adding the 1 x outputs bias row once when scaleTargets == 0.
fc.backward_semantics: Propagates input gradients dX[i] += dY * W[i]^T, averages bias gradients (1/numCases) * sum_n dY_n, and (with useGrad=false) accumulates momW[i]*V[i] + (epsW[i]/numCases) * (X[i]^T * dY) directly into _weightsInc[i].

softmax.inputs_spec: Single class-logit vector input (num_inputs = 1); Layer(..., trans=true) so activations have shape (numCases, numOut).
softmax.forward_semantics: Computes numerically stable per-case softmax probabilities p_c = exp(x_c - max_k x_k) / sum_j exp(x_j - max_k x_k) across the class dimension.
softmax.backward_semantics: When its sole consumer on the same GPU is cost.logreg (and _doLogregGrad is true), fuses the negative cross-entropy logit gradient dx_c = coeff * (1_{label==c} - p_c) via computeLogregSoftmaxGrad; otherwise computes p_c * sum_j dy_j * (1_{j==c} - p_j) via computeSoftmaxGrad.

cost.logreg.inputs_spec: Exactly 2 inputs in order: [0] 1-dimensional integer class labels, [1] softmax layer producing num_classes probabilities.
cost.logreg.forward_semantics: Evaluates per-case log(p_{label}) (averaging probabilities across views first during multiview testing) and records three batch sums in _costv: [-sum log(p_{label}), numCases - top1Correct, numCases - topkCorrect] (splitting probability ties fractional-fairly).

sections.forward_semantics: Final linear classifier on GPU 0: computes X_hs2a * W[0] + b (default initB=0.0) + X_hs2b * W[1] into 1000 raw class logits without any neuron nonlinearity.

sections.name: probs
sections.forward_semantics: Computes max-shifted 1000-way softmax probabilities p_c = exp(z_c - max_k z_k) / sum_j exp(z_j - max_k z_k) on inherited GPU 0.
sections.backward_semantics: Because its sole consumer on GPU 0 is cost.logreg layer logprob, computes the numerically stable fused negative gradient dz_c = coeff * (1_{label==c} - p_c) directly into fc1000's actsGrad.

open_questions.topic: Exact runtime input crop width (224 vs 227) in batches.meta and CLI --crop-border
open_questions.question: DataLayerParser queries train_data_provider.get_data_dims(idx=0) from batches.meta ('img_size') minus 2 * crop_border (default 4). Neither batches.meta nor the exact CLI invocation for layers-145 is in the repository; under layer.py's ceiling formula 1 + ceil((imgSize - 11)/4), any imgSize in {224, 225, 226, 227} produces 55x55 conv1 maps, with 224 matching the NIPS 2012 paper ('224x224 patches' from 256x256 with crop_border=16) via a 3-pixel zero-padded right/bottom partial boundary window.

open_questions.topic: Omitted cudaconv2 and nvmatrix C++/CUDA source files
open_questions.question: Makefile-distrib and build.sh reference external cudaconv2 and nvmatrix directories not included in AlexNet-Source-Code. Public cuda-convnet (r561) and cuda-convnet2 together pin down every kernel exercised by layers-145.cfg (including 9-arg convResponseNormCrossMap with both _denoms and _minDiv), but the exact September 2012 intermediate cudaconv2/nvmatrix files and unused kernels (convLocalRandomPool, convQuantizeHalf/convDequantizeHalf) are absent from this tree.

open_questions.topic: Host/GPU RNG streams and CUDA parallel floating-point summation order
open_questions.question: Weight initialization uses Python numpy.random.randn without a recorded seed in layer.py, dropout uses NVMatrix::randomizeUniform (CURAND device RNG), and CUDA reductions in convFilterActs/convWeightActs/NVMatrix depend on warp/block scheduling; bitwise trajectory parity with the 2012 hardware run is therefore unrecoverable from source.
